capabilities: render guitar chords and tabs from jtab codeblocks
insert example and chord-list codeblocks for browsing jTab syntax
put multiple jTab lines in one codeblock
embed markdown headings inside rendered codeblocks
customize rendering colors with themed, classic, or custom schemes
extras: README notes the underlying jTab library is not responsive, so rendering may vary on mobile, and wide renderings depend on line length; the jTab library is used under LGPL v2.1 and is unmodified except for disabling auto-render and wrapping in ES6.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render guitar chord diagrams and tab notation inside notes.

relations.evidence: It uses the jTab library to render the chords/tabs.
Used by jTab library - Raphael - MIT License

summary: Codeblock renderer that displays guitar chords and tablature in notes using the jTab library.
